content: अधिकृ €8 <ab>U.</ab> ²1 To authorize, qualify for the discharge of some duty; be entitled to, have a right to; नैवाध्यकारिष्महि वेदवृत्ते <ls>Bk. 2. 34</ls>; गुणाः प्रियत्वेधिकृता न संस्तवः <ls>Ki. 4. 25</ls> merits are calculated to produce liking, not mere intimacy. .²2 To place at the head of, appoint, set; पाण्डवेन ह्यहं तात अश्वेष्वधिकृतः पुरा <ls>Mb.</ls>; दृप्तविनयाधिकृतः <ls>R. 9. 62</ls> appointed to humble the proud; शिथिलीकृतेऽधिकृतकृत्यविधौ <ls>Ki. 6. 30</ls> set or appointed to duty; देवाः प्रसह्य तमधिकुर्युः <ls>Mv. 2</ls> set on, incite or appoint as their chief. .²3 To aim at, allude or refer to, make the subject of; अधिकृत्य कृते ग्रन्थे <ls>P. IV. 3. 87</ls>; किरातार्जुनौ अधिकृत्य कृतं काव्यं किरातार्जुनीयम् <ls>Sk.</ls>; नाटकं प्रयोगेण अधिक्रियताम् <ls>Ś. 1</ls> should be made the subject of representation, should be represented on the stage. .²4 To be used as the head or governing rule; समर्थानां प्रथमाद्वा <ls>P. IV. 1. 82</ls>; इदं पदत्रयमधिक्रियते <ls>Sk.</ls> .²5 To superintend, be at the head. .²6 (<ab>Ā.</ab>) To bear, endure or overpower, be superior to; शत्रुमधिकुरुते <ls>Sk.</ls>; अधिचक्रे न यं हरिः <ls>Bk. 8. 20</ls>. .²7 To feel, enjoy; भवादृशाश्चेदधिकुर्वते रतिं निराश्रया हन्त हता मनस्विता <ls>Ki. 1. 43</ls>. .²8 To refrain or desist from.
